name: August 23, 2022 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  MALIBU ARTS COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  AUGUST 23, 2022
  TELECONFERENCED - VARIO US LOCATIONS
  9:00AM.

The following meeting was held pursuant to AB 361 and fully teleconferenced from various
locations during the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Cherin called the meeting to order at 9:04 a.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance via teleconference by the Recording
  Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Lotte Cherin, Vice Chair Fireball Lawrence; Commissioners Barry
  Haldeman, Peter Jones; and Ex-Officio Clifford

  ABSENT: Commissioner Julia Holland

  ALSO PRESENT: Jesse Bobbett, Community Services Director; Kristin Riesgo,
  Community Services Deputy Director; and Brittany Saleaumua, Administrative Assistant

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chair Cherin led the Pledge of Allegiance.

CITY OF MALIBU VISION STATEMENT

  Commissioner Jones read the City of Malibu Vision Statement.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  Chair Cherin suggested moving Item No. 2.B. after Item No. 4.C. to ensure all items on the
  agenda could be heard.

  Vice Chair Lawrence requested Item No. 5.A. be moved to after Item No. 2.A.

MOTION  Chair Cherin moved, and Commissioner Jones seconded a motion to approve the
  agenda as amended. The question was called, and the motion carried 4-0,
  Commissioner Holland absent.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting

  Page 2 of7

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported the agenda for the meeting was properly
  posted on August 18, 2022.

ITEM I  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  None.

ITEM 2.A.  PUBLIC COMMENTS

  None.

ITEMS  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Malibu City Gallery Exhibition Schedule
  Recommended Action: Review and approve the Malibu Public Art Exhibitions Ad
  Hoc Committee's recommended City Hall Art Exhibitions for Fiscal Year 2022-
  2023.

  Commissioner Lawrence presented the City Hall Art Exhibition schedule for Fiscal
  Year 2022-2023 with the amendment of including Heather Edwards as a single
  artist.

  In response to Commissioner Jones, Commissioner Lawrence stated there would
  not be a break in the exhibition schedule provided artist Heather Edwards delivered
  her artwork on time.

  Ex-Officio Clifford stated he would forward artist information to Vice Chair
  Lawrence for future consideration in an exhibition. He requested information
  regarding artwork medium be listed on gallery labels.

  Commissioner Haldeman inquired about utilizing quick response (QR) codes on
  gallery labels to direct visitors to the artist's website.

  In response to Commissioner Haldeman, Vice Chair Lawrence stated Ms. Edward's
  artwork was inspired by Disney.

  In response to Commissioner Haldeman and Chair Cherin, Community Services
  Deputy Director Riesgo stated she was working with Vice Chair Lawrence to
  design signage in three areas directing guests to the Malibu City Gallery.

  In response to Commissioner Haldeman, Vice Chair Lawrence stated the exhibition
  schedule for Fiscal Year 2022-2023 would feature single and multi-artist
  exhibitions as well as a student artist exhibition. He stated Ms. Edwards would be

  a single artist exhibition and he would provide staff a link to Ms. Edwards' artwork
  to forward to the Commission.

MOTION  Chair Cherin moved, and Commissioner Jones seconded a motion to approve the
  amended exhibition schedule as discussed. The question was called, and the motion
  carried 4-0; Commissioner Holland absent.

ITEM3  CONSENT CALENDAR

  Commissioner Haldeman pulled Item No. 3.B.l.

MOTION  Chair Cherin moved, and Commissioner Haldeman seconded a motion to approve
  the Consent Calendar; except for Item No. 3 .B .1. The question was called, and the
  motion carried 4-0; Commissioner Holland absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:

  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  1.  Approval of Minutes
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the May 24, 2022 Malibu
  Arts Commission Regular meeting and the July 26, 2022 Malibu Arts
  Commission Regular meeting.

  The following item was pulled from the Consent Calendar for individual consideration:

  B.  New Items
  1.  Approval of Minutes
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the May 24, 2022 Malibu
  Arts Commission Regular meeting and the July 26, 2022 Malibu Arts
  Commission Regular meeting.

  Commissioner Haldeman stated the July 26, 2022 Malibu Arts Commission
  Regular meeting minutes should reflect the $30,000 budget available for storage of
  the artwork and administrative costs in addition to the $225,000 project budget for
  the Solstice Canyon Creek Beautification Project.

CONSENSUS By Consensus, the Commission postponed further discussion regarding revisions
  to the minutes to the end of the meeting.

ITEM4  OLD BUSINESS

  A.  Solstice Canyon Creek Beautification Project
  Recommended Action: 1) Review the Solstice Canyon Creek Beautification
  Project; and 2) Provide direction to staff.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of August 23, 2022
  Page4 of7

Community Services Director Bobbett presented the staff report.

Chair Cherin stated she had spoken with Caltrans representative Hammer Sui and
the Commission was not required to have an artist finalized by October 31, 2022.
She stated the Commission could select an artist after October 31, 2022, and
suggested releasing a Call for Artists.

Vice Chair Lawrence stated the project was large and could be overwhelming to
review. He suggested creating an ad hoc committee to oversee the Call for Artists.

Commissioner Haldeman indicated agreement with Vice Chair Lawrence and
stated the Call for Artists should include language stating "Malibu artists were
preferred but not required." He stated the temporary artwork display location would
depend on the medium.

Ex-Officio Clifford stated the Commission was not required to have an open Call
for Artists and suggested each Commissioner recommend one artist for
consideration.

Commissioner Jones indicated oppos1t10n to Ex-Officio Clifford providing
feedback due to his non-voting status and suggested consulting with Caltrans
regarding which materials could tolerate salt due to its corrosive nature.

Chair Cherin stated her preference was to release a Call for Artists aimed at local
beach cities and giving preference to Malibu artists.

Commissioner Jones suggested each Commissioner recommend three local artists.
He stated if a commissioner could not recommend three artists, the remaining slots
could be distributed amongst other Commissioners.

Commissioner Haldeman stated he would prefer a Call for Artists limited to
California artists since the Solstice Canyon Creek Beautification project was a state
project.

In response to Chair Cherin, Vice Chair Lawrence stated an outside jury was not
required to select an artist from an open Call for Artists. He stated he understood
Chair Cherin's concerns, but felt it was the Commission's job to select the right
candidate and process. He stated the ideal artwork medium for the project would
be tile or street art.

Chair Cherin suggested Vice Chair Lawrence and Commissioner Jones serve on the
ad hoc committee to review submissions for the Solstice Canyon Creek
Beautification Project.

Vice Chair Lawrence and Commissioner Jones agreed to join the ad hoc committee.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of August 23, 2022
  Page 5 of7

  Chair Cherin proposed a Call for Artists with priority given to California artists
  local to the Malibu area.

  In response to Chair Cherin, Community Services Director Bobbett stated the
  artwork must be completed by June 2023.

  In response to Vice Chair Lawrence, Caltrans representative Vathana Chy stated a
  portion of the artwork could be stored during the bridge construction.

  In response to Ex-Officio Clifford, Mr. Chy stated the art component of the project
  would help create environmental awareness, but he was unsure if the bridge
  restoration would help restore movement for steelhead trout. He stated the tunnel
  reconstruction was due to recent structural tests showing signs of internal
  deterioration.

  In response to Commissioner Haldeman, Ex-Officio Clifford stated visitors would
  have access from the mountainside of the tunnel.

MOTION  Chair Cherin moved, and Commissioner Haldeman seconded a motion to create the
  Solstice Canyon Creek Beautification Project ad hoc consisting of Vice Chair
  Lawrence and Commissioner Jones and create a Call for Artists open to California
  artists with a preference for Malibu artists. The question was called, and the motion
  carried 4-0; Commissioner Holland absent.

  B.  Malibu Arts Center
  Recommended Action: Discuss ideas for an arts center in Malibu.

  Commissioner Jones proposed hiring Maya Lin to recommend improvements to the
  City Hall Theater and design an exterior entrance to the Malibu City Gallery for
  visitors to view the artwork on weekends.

  Commissioner Haldeman stated input from the community collected through a
  community survey would be best before deciding where an arts center could be
  constructed.

  In response to Chair Cherin, Community Services Director Bobbett recommended
  each Commissioner discuss their thoughts regarding an arts center with their
  respective Councilmember to determine what kind of support there is at the Council
  level regarding a community input process for an arts center. He also stated the
  Commission could request additional funding from City Council to hire consultants
  during the Mid-Year Budget Review in January 2023.

  C.  Malibu Arts Budget
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of August 23, 2022
  Page 6 of7

  Recommended Action: Receive and file a report regarding the Adopted Malibu
  Arts Budget for Fiscal Year 2022-2023.

  Community Services Director Bobbett presented the staff report.

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS

  1.  Arts in Education

  Chair Cherin stated Summer Jubilations occurred at Malibu Bluffs Park on
  August 10, 2022 and had an excellent turnout.

  2.  Malibu Public Art Exhibitions

  No updates.

  3.  Business and Community Outreach

  Commissioner Haldeman stated the Chamber of Commerce was moving
  forward with the Art in Business program.

  4.  Social Media

  Commissioner Lawrence stated Facebook posts on the Malibu Arts
  Commission page should be arts-related and consistent.

ITEM6  STAFF UPDATES

  No updates.

ITEM7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Commissioner Jones stated his poem was read at Summer Jubilations on August
  10, 2022, and a piece of his artwork would be on display at the Los Angeles County
  Museum of Art.

  Vice Chair Lawrence stated he was working on coloring books for Hilton Hotels
  and Pasadena Arts Center College of Design Car Classic 90 th Anniversary.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  None.

ADJOURNMENT

  to adjourn the meeting. The question was called, and the motion carried 4-0,
  Commissioner Holland absent.
